tasks.body:
import arrow
a=arrow.Arrow(2020,1,2,3,4,5)
b=a.replace(year=2022,hour=9,fold=1)
print(b,b.fold)
assert b.year==2022 and b.hour==9 and b.fold==1

tasks.contract: Publish supplied timezone and fold options without inverting the constructor default branch.
tasks.body:
import arrow
from dateutil import tz
zone=tz.gettz('America/New_York')
a=arrow.Arrow(2020,11,1,1,30,tzinfo=zone,fold=1)
print(a,a.fold,a.tzinfo)
assert a.fold==1 and a.tzinfo is zone
b=arrow.Arrow(2020,1,2)
assert b.tzinfo==tz.tzutc() and b.fold==0

Forward namespaces, custom selectors and flags to compilation in their original channels.
tasks.body:
import soupsieve as sv
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
s=BeautifulSoup('<root xmlns:x="urn:x"><x:a/></root>','xml')
p=sv.compile('x|a',namespaces={'x':'urn:x'})
print(len(p.select(s)))
assert len(p.select(s))==1
assert sv.compile(':--x',custom={':--x':'x|a'},namespaces={'x':'urn:x'}).select_one(s) is not None
